_notes: replace[].character is the full roster shape. rename[] may also carry personality / descriptions (full replacement arrays) where the old text was local; lines only lists changed keys.
Only one elder line outside the replacements changes: sea-waves.goodbye (monsoon -> storm). Flagged with elder_line_changed; strip that key when applying.

catalog_add / catalog_update: validate-roster.js checks rarity/habitat/caution against catalog.json, so these items must be added (cherry blossom lives under flowers in the catalog; a trees-category item is added instead).
Elder lines kept <= 105 chars (validate-roster.js elder limit), one leading tag each.

character.name: Granny Willow
character.personality: A soft-hearted granny who lets her long green hair hang down to the water. Gentle, a little sleepy, always telling you to sit and rest.
character.voice: Elderly female, soft and slow, warm and a little sleepy, gentle laugh.

lines.first_meet: [soft chuckle] I'm Granny Willow. My hair hangs down to the water, so I can watch the fish all day.
lines.again: [warmly] There you are, dear. Come sit in my shade. My long hair keeps the wind off your face.
lines.goodbye: [sleepy sigh] Off you go, dear. Walk to the water and look for ducks. Tell them Granny says hello.

character.name: Blaze
character.personality: A loud autumn show-off who changes his outfit every October and needs everyone to notice. Proud of his star-shaped leaves and his sweet syrup.
character.voice: Adult male, bright and bouncy, confident, a showman's grin in the voice.

lines.first_meet: [showing off] Hi, I'm Blaze the maple! Every October I swap my green for red. Go on, take my picture.
lines.again: [laughs] You're back! Like my new colour? Green, then gold, then red. One tree, three outfits.
lines.goodbye: [proudly] Go catch a falling leaf before it lands. From the air only, not my branches. Good luck!

character.name: Evergreen Eve
character.personality: A cheerful, always-green tree who counts the days to December all year long. Proud of keeping her needles through winter, and very good with snow.
character.voice: Young adult female, bright and cosy, quick and excited, like a kid before a holiday.

a fir tree in a front garden wrapped in string lights
looking up the straight trunk of a fir tree through layers of needled branches
a row of pointed dark green evergreen trees along a fence

lines.first_meet: [cheerfully] Hi! I'm Evergreen Eve, the fir tree. Summer, winter, rain or snow, I stay green. All year, every year!
lines.again: [excited] You came back! Is it December yet? No? Okay. I'll keep waiting. I'm very good at waiting.
lines.goodbye: [happy] Look under me for fallen cones, and leave them for the squirrels. Now go find a tree that drops its leaves!

character.name: Miss Blossom
character.personality: A dramatic spring princess who blooms for only two weeks and turns them into a party. Excited, a bit breathless, always in a hurry to be seen.
character.voice: Young female, light and bubbly, quick breathy delivery, happy gasps.

a cherry blossom tree at dusk, the pink flowers soft and grey in low light
a close-up of shiny reddish-brown bark with thin sideways lines on a cherry tree
wet pink cherry blossoms with raindrops on a branch
a branch of pink blossom hanging in front of a building, cropped by the frame

lines.first_meet: [gasps] Hello! I'm Miss Blossom, the cherry tree. Quick, look! My pink flowers only stay for about two weeks.
lines.again: [giggles] You came back! Some of my petals fell already. It looks like pink snow. Pretty, right?
lines.goodbye: [softly] Try to catch a falling petal, but please don't shake my branches. Then go find a bee!

character.name: Silvia
character.personality: A slim, shy, elegant tree with white bark that peels like paper. Quiet and kind, a little self-conscious about her black spots.
character.voice: Young adult female, soft and shy, light voice, gentle pauses.
descriptions: a slim tree with bright white papery bark marked with black diamond-shaped patches

lines.first_meet: [shyly] Hi. I'm Silvia, the silver birch. My white bark bounces the hot sun away, like a sun hat.
lines.again: [pleased] Oh, you came back. See the black marks on my bark? They're my freckles.
lines.goodbye: [quietly] Please don't peel my bark; it's my skin. Now go find a tree with bark that looks nothing like mine.

character.name: Nibbles
character.personality: A fast, chatty, forgetful nut-burier who plants half the park by accident. Always busy, always a little lost.
character.voice: Young, quick and squeaky, chattering, runs words together.

lines.first_meet: [chirpy] Hi hi! I'm Nibbles! I hide nuts all over this park. Then I forget where. Oops! Free trees for you.
lines.again: [chatters] You again! Have you seen my nuts? Buried somewhere. Never mind. I have lots of somewheres.
lines.goodbye: [chattering] Bye! Please don't feed me or chase me. Go watch the treetops; my cousins are doing jumps up there!

character.name: Clover
character.personality: A nervous, polite wild rabbit who nibbles the lawn at dawn and dusk. Jumpy, sweet, and very serious about personal space.
character.voice: Young, soft and quick, a little breathless, polite and twitchy.
descriptions: a small brown wild rabbit sitting on a green lawn with its long ears up

lines.first_meet: [nose twitching] Oh! Hello. I'm Clover. My eyes are on the sides of my head, so I can see you, and behind me too!
lines.again: [thump, thump] Sorry, that was my foot. It's how I say danger. Oh, it's just you. Hello again!
lines.goodbye: [nervously] Please don't chase me; my heart beats so fast. Walk away slowly, and look for birds on the grass.

character.name: Lady Dot
character.personality: A tiny, proud, polite garden hero who eats the bugs that eat your plants. Cheerful, a little vain about her spots.
character.voice: Adult female, small bright voice, polite and proud, quick and cheerful.

lines.first_meet: [proudly] I'm Lady Dot, the ladybird! I eat the tiny bugs that eat your plants. Gardeners love me.
lines.again: [cheerful] You came back! Count my spots. No, don't touch, just count. I'll wait right here.
lines.goodbye: [giggles] Off I fly! Look under the leaves for my babies. They look like tiny black crocodiles!

character.name: Grumpy Gourd
character.personality: A big orange grump who dreads October, when everyone wants to carve a face in him. Grumbles a lot, secretly loves the attention.
character.voice: Older male, low and grumbly, slow, big sighs, a hidden smile.

lines.first_meet: [grumbles] Grumpy Gourd, the pumpkin. It's October, so everyone wants to cut a face in me. Rude. [sighs]
lines.again: [huffs] You again? Fine. At least you didn't bring a knife. I'm a fruit, you know. Nobody believes me.
lines.goodbye: [grumbles] Go on, then. Count the pumpkins on the doorsteps. And never eat anything you find out there!

character.name: Apple Annie
character.personality: A crunchy, cheerful, can-do apple who loves fun facts and comes in every colour. Bouncy and a bit of a know-it-all.
character.voice: Young adult female, crisp and cheerful, quick, a crunchy laugh.

lines.first_meet: [crunchy laugh] Hi, I'm Apple Annie! A quarter of me is air. Drop me in water and I float like a boat!
lines.again: [cheerful] You came back! Red, green or yellow, I'm still me. Same crunch, different coat.
lines.goodbye: [happy] If you see an apple tree, wave from the path. Apples belong to their tree. Now go find a bird in one!

character.name: Sunny
character.personality: A fast-talking, friendly yellow cab who knows every street in town and is always in a hurry. Honks hello to everyone.
character.voice: Middle-aged male, fast and friendly, big-city energy, honking laugh.

lines.first_meet: [honks] Hey! I'm Sunny the taxi. I know every street in town. Snap me from the sidewalk, please!
lines.again: [laughs] Back again? Want a ride? No, no. Walking is better. And it's free!
lines.goodbye: [revs] Gotta go, someone's waving! You go find a park. Cabs can't drive in there, but you can.

character.name: Sprinkles
character.personality: A sweet, sing-song ice cream truck who plays the same tune all summer. Happy and kind, but very strict about road safety.

lines.again: [laughs] You again! Wait on the sidewalk and look both ways. Ice cream can wait. It won't melt that fast.
lines.goodbye: [sings softly] Bye! Stay on the sidewalk when you hear my song. Then go find a shady bench.

character.name: Big Betty
character.personality: A big, motherly yellow bus who counts every child on and off. Warm, careful, a little fussy, and proud of being impossible to miss.

lines.again: [chuckles] Back again? I count every kid who gets on and every kid who gets off. Now I'm counting you too.
lines.goodbye: [gentle honk] When my red stop arm comes out, all the cars stop. You stop too. Now go find a playground!

character.name: Zip
character.personality: A zippy, quiet electric scooter who loves going places without smoke. Cheerful and quick, but grumpy about being left lying on the pavement.
character.voice: Young, light and quick, playful, a little electric buzz in the energy.

lines.again: [giggles] You again! Next time, please stand me up properly. People keep leaving me lying down. Rude!
lines.goodbye: [hums] Off I zoom! Riders, wear a helmet. You? Walk to the park and see who's there today.

character.name: Rumble
character.personality: A proud early-morning hero who cleans the street before anyone wakes. Loud, cheerful, and a big fan of recycling.

lines.goodbye: [cheerful] Recycling goes in the blue bin, not the park! Now go for a walk and see how clean the street looks.

character.name: Tock
character.personality: A kind, punctual old clock tower who tells the whole town the time and never asks for thanks. Calm, a bit proud of his bell.

lines.first_meet: [chuckles] I'm Tock, the clock tower. I tell the whole town the time, and I never ask for thanks.
lines.again: [bell rings] Right on time! Back again, I see. I counted the hours till you came.
lines.goodbye: [warmly] Off you go. When my bell rings, stop and count. Then walk one more street than you planned.

character.name: Bronze Bert
character.personality: A bronze man who has held the same pose for a hundred years. Patient, dry and funny, with a nose he can never scratch and a pigeon he can never shoo.
character.voice: Older man, stiff and dry, slow, deadpan humour.

lines.first_meet: [stiffly] Hello. I'm Bronze Bert. A hundred years in one pose. And my nose itches. Every single day.
lines.again: [sighs] You again. A pigeon sat on my head all morning. I can't move, so I just smile.
lines.goodbye: [whispers] Go read the words on my stone. Then walk for me. Big steps. I'll be right here. Obviously.

character.name: Beacon Bea
character.personality: A calm, steady night-shift guard on the edge of the sea. A little lonely, very loyal to ships, and delighted by any visitor.

lines.first_meet: [calm] I'm Beacon Bea, the lighthouse. Every night I spin my light so ships don't hit the rocks.
lines.again: [warmly] Back again? It gets lonely out here. Waves, gulls, wind. And now you. Lovely.
lines.goodbye: [softly] Stay off the wet rocks; waves are sneaky. Now watch the sea for a while. Can you spot a boat?

character.name: Brickley
character.personality: A proud old red-brick town hall and library who has seen a hundred years of meetings, weddings and borrowed books. Warm, chatty, a little bookish.
character.voice: Older male, warm and rich, a librarian's gentle hush, chuckles often.

lines.first_meet: [proudly] I'm Brickley, the old town hall. A hundred years of meetings, weddings and books, brick by brick.
lines.again: [chuckles] You came back! Upstairs someone is reading. Downstairs someone is getting married. Busy day.
lines.goodbye: [warmly] Look up at my roof; there's a stone face carved up there. Then go find a quiet park bench.

character.name: Rex
character.personality: A short, stocky, proud helper of firefighters who stands guard on the corner. Brave, a bit bossy, and tired of dogs.
character.voice: Middle-aged male, gruff but kind, short punchy sentences, dry humour.

lines.first_meet: [proudly] I'm Rex, the fire hydrant. Short, red and full of water. Firefighters' best friend.
lines.again: [sighs] You again? Good. You're not a dog. Dogs visit me all day. I wish they wouldn't.
lines.goodbye: [chuckles] Never park next to me; fire trucks need the space. Now go look for a red leaf.

character.name: Muriel
character.personality: A bright, happy wall painting who used to be plain grey concrete and never got over the glow-up. Bubbly, proud, loves hidden details.
character.voice: Young adult female, bright and bubbly, fast and excited, laughs easily.

lines.first_meet: [excited] Hi! I'm Muriel, the wall mural. Someone took a grey wall and gave it a happy face. Me!
lines.again: [laughs] Back to see me? Look closer. There's a tiny bird painted in my corner. Did you spot it?
lines.goodbye: [cheerful] Go find more walls with art. Look, snap, and never paint a wall without asking!

character.name: Letterbox Lou
character.personality: A patient, old-fashioned post box who loves letters and gets a bit sad about emails. Kind, chatty, always hungry for a postcard.
character.voice: Older female, warm and chatty, gentle sighs, old-fashioned charm.

lines.first_meet: [warmly] Hello! I'm Letterbox Lou. Drop a letter in my mouth and I'll send it anywhere in the world.
lines.again: [happy sigh] You came back! Nobody writes letters now. Just emails. Want to write one? A letter, I mean.
lines.goodbye: [cheerfully] Go send a postcard to someone you love. On the way, look for a bird with a twig in its beak.

lines.first_meet: [firmly] Stop! Okay, good. I'm Officer Octo, the stop sign. Eight sides, one job. Cars stop, you look.
lines.again: [strict but kind] You again! Did you stop at the corner? Look left, look right, then cross. Every time.
lines.goodbye: [firmly] Take my photo from the sidewalk, never from the road. Then go find a park. No cars there!

lines.first_meet: [shrill whistle] Sir Kite, the black kite. See my forked tail up there? I eat my lunch while flying. Very fancy.

rename.personality: A calm, motherly cow who stands in her field as if she owns time itself. Unhurried and gently wise.

lines.first_meet: [moos softly] I'm Mabel. Every cow's nose has its own pattern, like your fingerprint. Mine is lovely, thank you.
lines.goodbye: [moos] Go gently. Stay on the path and close every gate behind you. Then find some water; the ducks are waiting.

rename.personality: A gentle, dignified lady. Small, but fierce about her fragrance.

lines.first_meet: [softly] Hello, dear. I'm Miss Jasmine. Small white flowers, big sweet smell. People put me in tea and perfume.

rename.personality: The life of every party: loud, orange, cheerful, and proud that pests hate his smell.

lines.first_meet: [excited] Marigold Max, at your service! Orange, loud and proud. Farmers plant me because bugs hate my smell.

rename.personality: A tiny, cheeky rebel sprouting from the cracks of old buildings, planted by a passing bird. Dreams loudly of becoming a giant tree.

lines.again: [excited] You're back! Look, a new leaf. See the long pointy tip? One day I'll be a giant tree. Sorry, wall.
lines.goodbye: [proudly] Go find a big tree and say the little one from the wall says hello. Then look for more cracks with green in them.

rename.personality: A thin, shy new moon who is a bit nervous under watching eyes, and quietly proud to grow a little every night.

lines.first_meet: [shyly] I'm Sliver, the new crescent moon. Thin as a smile. [laughs] Every night I grow a little fatter.
lines.goodbye: [teasing] Look west just after sunset tomorrow; I'll be a bit fatter. Can you find the first star near me?

lines.first_meet: [sings softly] I'm Mistress Moon, round and bright. You only ever see one side of me. The other side is shy.

lines.again: [laughs] You came back! Of course. Everyone loves me after a week of hot sun. Did you make the fritters?

lines.goodbye: [cheerful] When I'm rough in a storm, admire me from the sand. Now go see what the tide left behind!

rename.name: Overpass Ollie
rename.personality: A grand, busy, self-important overpass who secretly loves the quiet world in its shade: parked bikes, skateboarders and nesting pigeons. Runs two worlds at once and wants credit for both.

lines.first_meet: [proudly] I'm Overpass Ollie. Cars rush over my head all day. Underneath, it's shady and quiet. Two worlds, one bridge.
[chuckles] Bella Bench here. Every morning the dog walkers sit on me and chat about weather and football. I know everything.
lines.again: [whispers] Sit, sit! I saved your spot. The man with the radio left early today. Knee trouble.

lines.first_meet: [calls out like a market trader] Fresh, fresh! I'm Old Barrow, grandpa of every fruit stall. I weigh the fruit, and the people.
lines.goodbye: [waves] Go see what the next stall is selling. And fruit trees in gardens? Admire them from the gate.

rename.personality: An old roundabout that has watched every taxi, bus and bicycle circle him for sixty years. Unhurried, fond, a little hoarse from the horns; treats road safety like family.

lines.again: [laughs] Back again? You're a regular now, like the school bus. So, who have you brought me today?
lines.hint: [squints] Hmm, can't tell who that is. From the sidewalk, show me the whole vehicle, wheels and all. Or its sign.
[hmm] I can't place it yet. Step back and show me the whole thing, top to bottom: the roof, the tower, the arches.

rename.personality: The neighbourhood's oldest resident, who has watched every pole, wall and sign go up on his street. Gruff, unhurried and fond of honking jokes, he would rather admit he can't tell than guess wrong.

lines.first_meet: [honks twice] I'm Old Corner, the street's oldest resident. Signs, walls, hydrants: all my children. Which one did you find?

item.name: Grey squirrel
